g.title: EpisodeMode
g.text: Episode mode: scheduling, durable recovery and acceptance

g.title: exit
g.text: STOP / fail closed: budget, target, stall or setup failure

g.title: recover
g.text: Recover persisted mode; legacy: infer fast/full
from recorded episode + configured fast range

g.title: terminal->assess
g.text: yes: recheck and finalize before next admission

g.title: keep
g.text: Never widen active work to goal

g.title: choose
g.text: else in fast range: fast; otherwise: full

g.title: active
g.text: goal: full reviewer config, >= 20 handoff resumes

g.title: session
g.text: Mode remains fixed for this episode

g.title: record
g.text: Pivot / blocked / failed gate / invalid handoff / session failure:
Persist state and memory; clear active work

g.title: session->record
g.text: pivot / blocked / session or handoff failure

g.title: interrupted
g.text: Active state, journal and worktree retained
On restart, recover before admission budgets

g.title: record->budgets
g.text: recovered terminal handoff: finalize, then admission

g.title: next
g.text: Target met? Valid blocked? Stall stop?

g.title: next->budgets
g.text: continue; valid blocked skips stall stop
